status: Freeze step F4 (SPEC_V3.md section 8) at revision 5: committed after both F3 commits (configs_v3/freeze_f3.json) and before any held-out device was converted, scored or simulated. Seen beforehand: what SPEC_V3.md section 1 lists. F4 is the last commit that touches this file; it is tagged v3-held-out-config and its hash is recorded with a server-side timestamp before any conversion (DECISIONS_V3.md P2-38). Every run of this config uses nac_bench.run_v3 at a clean commit that contains this file.

settings.readout: each qubit's reset flip probability equals its readout flip probability (P1-13, the headline setting)
settings.zero: reset flip probability 0 on every qubit, as in the converted snapshots (the bridge to v1 and v2)

device_roles.confirmatory: in the family; claims cite these devices
device_roles.seen: calibration partly seen before F4 (SPEC_V3.md section 1); every case runs, exploratory, never in the family or a claim
device_roles.synthetic: synthetic calibration; every case runs, exploratory, labelled synthetic

circuit_note: Native CZ circuits (R3-C2, R3-S4); the surface code is the rotated Z-memory with both hook-safe schedules as candidates
seed_note: New and disjoint from every v1 (20261011-13), v2 (20261021-23, 20261031) and v3 Phase 1 (20261108-10) seed. Main-stage chunk k of a placement on base seed b: derive_seed('eval-v3-held-out', b, case_id, key, k); pilot: derive_seed('pilot-v3-held-out', pilot_seed, case_id, key, k); the R3-C5 random sample and the Nove checks: seeds derived from sample_seed and the case id ('sample-v3-held-out', 'check-v3-held-out'); the d-round sensitivity run (R3-C10): pilot derive_seed('pilot-v3-rounds', pilot_seed, case_id, key, k) and main stage derive_seed('eval-v3-rounds', b, case_id, key, k); the correlated re-decode reuses the main stage's chunk seeds, so it decodes the same samples

shots_rule.description: R3-C6: every simulated placement gets one 100,000-shot pilot on the pilot seed; its main-stage shots per seed are the smallest 200,000 x 2^k with 3 x shots x p >= F, capped at C (p = 0 gives the cap). A family placement (the headline method's and the headline references' choices, at both settings, on the confirmatory and synthetic devices) gets F = 4,000 and C = 102,400,000; every other placement F = 400 and C = 25,600,000. Pilot counts set shots and may select (pilot-best) but never enter a failure rate; only main-stage counts on the three base seeds do

best_found.description: R3-C5, on the square lattice at d=5 and d=7: every method's choice, the top 30 by the decoder-graph score, summed error and mapomatic's cost, and 100 uniform placements; every placement elsewhere

sensitivity.applies_to: the family placements of the confirmatory devices at the headline setting
sensitivity.correlated_matching: R3-C10: the main stage's samples decoded again with PyMatching's correlated matching (enable_correlations=True)

rounds_equal_distance.description: R3-C10: D5 and D7 simulated again with d rounds, with their own pilot and the family's shots rule

verdict_rule: P1-1: better when the upper end of the 95% Newcombe interval for P_L(choice) - P_L(reference) is below zero, worse when its lower end is above zero, otherwise tie; the same placement is a tie
test: two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test on the main-stage failure counts pooled over the three base seeds; Holm's step-down correction over each family; better after Holm when Holm rejects and P_L(choice) - P_L(reference) < 0, worse after Holm when Holm rejects and the difference > 0

claim_rules.threshold_rule: t = floor(n / 2) + 1: better after Holm in more than half of the layout's n repetition cases
claim_rules.description: Per layout and reference, from the family at the headline setting: 'beats X on <devices> (<layout>), under this noise model' when better after Holm in at least t cases and worse in none; 'mixed against X ...: better in N cases, worse in M (named)' when better in at least one and worse in at least one; 'loses to X ... (named)' when worse in at least one and better in none; otherwise 'no difference shown against X ...'. Surface code, per confirmatory device and reference: 'beats' / 'loses to' when better / worse after Holm, otherwise 'no difference shown'. A case or comparison with no valid placement leaves the family and t does not change. The isolation family uses the same rules
